displayName: Disable Keyboard Filter For Administrators (Windows Insiders only)
description:
Determines if Keyboard Filter should be disabled for administrators. Defaults to false. If an admin is currently signed in when this value is set, it will take effect on the next sign-in. 
 This setting is only available to Windows Insiders
